questions.query: Does metered Liquid Drain four-worker qualification require four actual claimants in the native large-tank arms and in the small Godot fixture?
facts: Exactly four distinct phase claimants are required in each of eight large standalone four-worker arms and exactly one in controls.
The small 312-cell Godot fixture observes at most two with four configured workers; no four-claimant application claim.

Every helper preflight/post inspection plus10/6/8 identity reserves and original source/mask and optional observation reads remain counted.
